title: Incorrect early return in parse_cookie
detail: When a cookie header is present, the function returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict immediately, skipping the actual parsing logic. This means any valid cookie string is ignored. Additionally, if the cookie header is missing (cookie is None), the code later attempts to call cookie.find, causing an AttributeError.
note: Describes the planted negation: a cookie string that's there is never parsed.

title: Incorrect file handling logic
detail: The condition now skips processing any file pointer that is not None, causing all files to be ignored. The original code only skipped when fp was None, allowing valid file objects to be processed.
note: Describes the planted flip: every file that is set gets skipped.

title: Uncaught ImportError on vendor module lookup
detail: The function now returns a ModuleType but does not handle ImportError. If a vendor module name is invalid or missing, importlib.import_module will raise ImportError, propagating to callers and potentially crashing the program. The original code used __import__ and returned getattr, which also raised ImportError but callers may have expected a None fallback.
